checksums.name: slot_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: stored_byte = (sum of all bytes in the slot's covered range [0..N], where N = ROM constant _DAT_080104bc not captured in this decompilation dump, computed while including the stale byte at local offset +9 and then subtracting that same stale byte back out) mod 256. Net effect: an 8-bit additive checksum of every byte in the covered range except the checksum byte itself, stored back at local offset +9 of each 976-byte slot.

fields.name: magic_signature
fields.update_mechanism: Literal byte-by-byte store in FUN_08010158, triggered only when the existing header fails its mismatch check against uncaptured expected constants.
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_08010158 byte stores reproduce the exact ASCII sequence found at saves/cap-00-future-0.sav offset 0x0000.

fields.name: header_padding
fields.update_mechanism: Unknown; no explicit store instruction for these 5 bytes was located in the decompiled header-write path (0x08010158/0x0801026c). Value is only confirmed empirically from the sample.
fields.evidence: saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt shows zero bytes at offset 0x000b-0x000f; no corresponding write instruction found in ghidra/decompiled.c.

fields.name: slot_checksum_byte

observed_values.saves/cap-00-future-0.sav: 0x00 (slot 0, and all 7 other slots at their respective +9 offsets)

fields.update_mechanism: Computed by FUN_08010490 as sum8-excluding-self over the slot's covered byte range, stored by FUN_08010320 at local slot offset +9 every time the slot is (re)written.
fields.evidence: Formula in ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_08010490; position/resting-value verified numerically against all 8 slots in saves/cap-00-future-0.sav, but the all-zero sample cannot disambiguate the exact coverage length N.

fields.name: slot_body_unmapped
fields.update_mechanism: Bulk byte-copy in FUN_08010320 treats the whole 976-byte slot opaquely except for the explicitly-addressed checksum byte at +9; no individual gameplay field boundaries could be derived from this workspace.
fields.evidence: Only a blank/never-played save sample is available; a post-gameplay non-blank .sav is required to map any field inside the slot body.

fields.name: unused_sram_tail
fields.update_mechanism: No code in the decompiled corpus addresses any location in this range.
fields.evidence: Directly observed byte range in saves/cap-00-future-0.sav; corroborated by absence of any matching address arithmetic in ghidra/decompiled.c.
